description: Return the figures Alfa Laval printed for one machine: sections, rows, columns and values with units as printed, plus the Alfa Laval document number and date. Covers MAB 204, 205, 206, 207 and 209 (also typed as MAB204, MAB-204 or MAB 204S), MAPX 204 and MOPX 205, 207, 209, 210 and 213. These are figures as printed by Alfa Laval in the named document, units as printed, not Dolphin measurements, guarantees or ratings; nothing is converted or calculated. A cell marked "not offered" could not be read with certainty and must not be filled in.

document.description: Optional Alfa Laval document number or id, e.g. "TD S93303E" or "MPCO 20-00-02". Omit for every document that covers the machine.
